content.title: Update docs for configurable branch feature
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

The --branch flag was implemented (mpe3seanai) and validated (mpe3smr0kk) but docs were never updated. This is a retroactive docs+build task.

Files that need updating in docs/markdown/:
- cli-reference.md: Document --branch flag on agt init, add flag to init command section, update push/pull to mention they resolve branch from config
- getting-started.md: Add --branch example alongside default init
- storing-issues-in-git.md: Explain configurable branch names, show examples of multiple instances, update hardcoded _agentrack references to explain it's the default
- overview.md: If init is mentioned, note the --branch option

Also: rebuild dist/ to ensure the build is current.

content.content: Context: This task was missed during the original configurable-branch issue chain. The --branch flag was implemented and validated but docs+build were skipped. This violates the api_change_policy (any CLI change must route to library-releaser for build + docs). The three docs files that need the most work are cli-reference.md (add --branch flag docs), getting-started.md (add --branch example), and storing-issues-in-git.md (explain configurable branches). See the spec at .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md for the full feature description including normalization rules, examples, and config schema.

Blocked: The --branch flag was never actually implemented in the codebase. I checked all source files thoroughly:

- packages/library/src/cli/commands/init.ts: No --branch option, initAction() takes no parameters
- packages/library/src/cli/runner.ts: init command registered without any flags
- packages/library/src/core/worktree.ts: Still uses hardcoded WORKTREE_BRANCH='_agentrack' and WORKTREE_DIR='.agentrack'
- No normalizeBranchName(), resolveWorktreePaths(), getWorktreeDir() functions exist
- No INVALID_BRANCH_NAME or BRANCH_CONFLICT error codes
- No branch field in config types

The original implementation issue mpe3seanai was closed as a 'duplicate of mpe3qrgb9x', which was also closed. But neither issue's code changes exist in the git history — the feature was never committed.

I cannot document a feature that doesn't exist, and building dist would not include it. The implementation needs to happen first before I can update docs and rebuild.

Recommendation: Create a new implementation task for the --branch flag, then loop back to this docs task.
